\section[(dialogue)]{Things at home and outdoors — a first pass}

\label{lesson:JA-R111-first-pass-things-at-home-and-outdoors}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a road and a pavement.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item the laundry, detergent, a teacup, a rice pot, a chopping board
  \item a ladle, the water supply, a kettle, a tray, a can
  \item a parcel, an envelope, a gift, a ball, a bell
  \item a hakama, a cotton kimono, a flame, a lamp, light
  \item a gate, a wood, a bud, a rock, a pebble
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
The laundry? (\textbf{\ja{せんたくもの}}, \emph{sentakumono}.) Detergent? (\textbf{\ja{せんざい}}, \emph{senzai}.) A teacup? (\textbf{\ja{ゆのみ}}, \emph{yunomi}.) A rice pot? (\textbf{\ja{かま}}, \emph{kama}.) A chopping board? (\textbf{\ja{まないた}}, \emph{manaita}.) A ladle? (\textbf{\ja{おたま}}, \emph{otama}.) The water supply? (\textbf{\ja{すいどう}}, \emph{suidou}.) A kettle? (\textbf{\ja{やかん}}, \emph{yakan}.) A tray? (\textbf{\ja{おぼん}}, \emph{obon}.) A can? (\textbf{\ja{かん}}, \emph{kan}.) A parcel? (\textbf{\ja{つつみ}}, \emph{tsutsumi}.) An envelope? (\textbf{\ja{ふうとう}}, \emph{fuutou}.) A gift? (\textbf{\ja{おくりもの}}, \emph{okurimono}.) A ball? (\textbf{\ja{まり}}, \emph{mari}.) A bell? (\textbf{\ja{かね}}, \emph{kane}.) A hakama? (\textbf{\ja{はかま}}, \emph{hakama}.) A cotton kimono? (\textbf{\ja{ゆかた}}, \emph{yukata}.) A flame? (\textbf{\ja{ほのお}}, \emph{honoo}.) A lamp? (\textbf{\ja{あかり}}, \emph{akari}.) Light? (\textbf{\ja{ひかり}}, \emph{hikari}.) A gate? (\textbf{\ja{もん}}, \emph{mon}.) A wood? (\textbf{\ja{はやし}}, \emph{hayashi}.) A bud? (\textbf{\ja{つぼみ}}, \emph{tsubomi}.) A rock? (\textbf{\ja{いわ}}, \emph{iwa}.) A pebble? (\textbf{\ja{こいし}}, \emph{koishi}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Nature and animals — a second pass}

\label{lesson:JA-R111-second-pass-nature-and-animals}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for mud and dust.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item mud, dust, foam, dew; the rainy season, a slope
  \item a shellfish, a sea bream, a shark, a squirrel, a wild boar
  \item a wild duck, an eagle, a hawk, an owl, a silkworm
  \item a fly, a snail, a tail, a heel, a shin
  \item the forehead, a nurse, a castle; the colour white, a road, a pavement
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Mud? (\textbf{\ja{どろ}}, \emph{doro}.) Dust? (\textbf{\ja{ほこり}}, \emph{hokori}.) Foam? (\textbf{\ja{あわ}}, \emph{awa}.) Dew; the rainy season? (\textbf{\ja{つゆ}}, \emph{tsuyu}.) A slope? (\textbf{\ja{さか}}, \emph{saka}.) A shellfish? (\textbf{\ja{かい}}, \emph{kai}.) A sea bream? (\textbf{\ja{たい}}, \emph{tai}.) A shark? (\textbf{\ja{さめ}}, \emph{same}.) A squirrel? (\textbf{\ja{りす}}, \emph{risu}.) A wild boar? (\textbf{\ja{いのしし}}, \emph{inoshishi}.) A wild duck? (\textbf{\ja{かも}}, \emph{kamo}.) An eagle? (\textbf{\ja{わし}}, \emph{washi}.) A hawk? (\textbf{\ja{たか}}, \emph{taka}.) An owl? (\textbf{\ja{ふくろう}}, \emph{fukurou}.) A silkworm? (\textbf{\ja{かいこ}}, \emph{kaiko}.) A fly? (\textbf{\ja{はえ}}, \emph{hae}.) A snail? (\textbf{\ja{かたつむり}}, \emph{katatsumuri}.) A tail? (\textbf{\ja{しっぽ}}, \emph{shippo}.) A heel? (\textbf{\ja{かかと}}, \emph{kakato}.) A shin? (\textbf{\ja{すね}}, \emph{sune}.) The forehead? (\textbf{\ja{ひたい}}, \emph{hitai}.) A nurse? (\textbf{\ja{かんごし}}, \emph{kangoshi}.) A castle; the colour white? (\textbf{\ja{しろ}}, \emph{shiro}.) A road? (\textbf{\ja{どうろ}}, \emph{douro}.) A pavement? (\textbf{\ja{ほどう}}, \emph{hodou}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
